# Open Polici

Open Polici is a consumer-controlled insurance marketplace serving Nevada at initial launch.

## Public pages

- https://openpolici.com/consumers - Consumer marketplace overview and account entry
- https://openpolici.com/providers - Provider and carrier marketplace overview, membership, and onboarding
- https://openpolici.com/about - Mission, operating model, privacy principles, and marketplace roles
- https://openpolici.com/insurance-comparison - Factual explanation and example of the insurance offer comparison method
- https://openpolici.com/developers - Governed marketplace integration architecture and controlled developer access

## Platform model

Consumers either upload an existing insurance declarations document or define a requested-coverage baseline. Eligible providers may independently submit documented offers. Consumers compare factual coverage and price differences, select an offer, and explicitly authorize disclosure to one selected provider.

Open Polici does not sell consumer contact lists, recommend which insurance policy a consumer should purchase, or grant insurance authority through payment. Provider licensing, jurisdiction, insurance-line eligibility, carrier relationships, commercial membership, and consumer authorization are separate controls.

## Current accepted Nevada document lines

Personal auto, homeowners, renters, commercial auto, commercial general liability, and business owners policy.

## Commercial model

Provider access follows Open Policy Commercial V2. The only billable marketplace transaction event is a qualifying consumer-authorized connection. Membership and optional services are separate from marketplace transaction charges.
